title: Rubric - Overfitting
evidence: Criteria test at the right level of specificity without overfitting to implementation details. Criterion 11 explicitly allows 'Alternative implementations that produce the same outward dispersal'. Visual criteria use 'consistent with the corresponding expected file' rather than pixel-exact matching. Telemetry criteria specify format structure but allow runtime variation (criterion 10 allows ±10%, criterion 30 allows ±20%). Criteria test observable outputs (file contents, screenshot appearance, console log) rather than implementation internals (no criteria about specific node types, class names, or code patterns). The criteria would accept any correct Godot implementation that produces the specified outputs.
